derivation: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3598 (ὁδός) ("synod");
def: companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan

occurrences.text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
